pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, sub-polygonal patches with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Internal patch color is a uniform medium-brown with no significant interior textural variation.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial with consistent pixel thickness across the visible flank and neck topology.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-profile, dark-colored mane along the dorsal ridge from neck to shoulder. The silhouette shows low-amplitude, high-frequency serration against the background, indicative of short, dense hair.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct avian subjects (Oxpeckers) are visible on the giraffe: one perched on the upper neck/shoulder transition and a second on the lower posterior flank.
